current: qip_events::EventLog is append-only and hash-chained, and qip-kernel replays from it at assembly: Platform::resume_ledger (declared inflows), resume_capital_calls (the commitment book), resume_fabric (FabricJournal) and, since 2026-10-05, Platform::resume_book.
